stages.description: Create a separate source tree for original build artifacts.
Copy the pinned build checkout into an isolated Linux volume (bind mounts cannot carry Linux exec bits).
Restore the exact source lockfiles in an isolated container; no host profile or credentials are mounted.
Build the original site for locale 'en' with only public dependency fetches; no credentials are present.
stages.command: corepack yarn workspace website docusaurus build --locale en --out-dir build

stages.description: Collect route paths and static source metadata from original locale build 'en'.
Merge locale route snapshots and reject conflicting route metadata.
Copy only fixed input mappings into the migration analyzer root.
Analyze and convert the fixed mapped source with the V110-20 route oracle.
Record every non-automatic action, source fingerprint, span and functional difference; no patch is silently accepted.
Restore first-party worker packages from npm lockfile with lifecycle scripts disabled and no credentials.
Build the bounded clean-page candidate offline; MDX and user modules remain inside Docker.
Serve candidate pages over loopback and test navigation/assets/search offline.
